correctness.rationale: The three-action local payoff conditions are necessary and sufficient. Equality edges cover conformist runs with no adjacent omissions, giving exact binomial coefficients. Contracting equal edges reduces color assignment to a cycle chromatic count, including the two-block boundary. Summation establishes the formula for all n>=3 and m>=3; direct payoff-search and local-rule enumerators ran successfully on 667 and 1,252 test cases, respectively. Finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The natural unresolved multiplicity question left by a sharp existence criterion is answered for every heterogeneous C/R cycle and every common m>=3 action set. The exact polynomial provides the disagreement-edge distribution, a nontrivial invariance under rearrangement of run lengths, and explicit exponential counts/probabilities in periodic settings. This is a meaningful infinite-family quantification rather than a small numerical recomputation.
